excludes: 2-point conversions, fumbles lost, return touchdowns - not attributable to the defense faced, or not scrimmage production
policy: regular season only; sums not means so any week window recomposes by addition; `off` is production BY that team, `def` is production ALLOWED by that team
scoring: ppr_scrimmage = rec*1 + (rec_yds + rush_yds)*0.1 + (rec_td + rush_td)*6 + pass_yds*0.04 + pass_td*4 - int*2
